title: Page 5
content_zh:
男人大多喜爱女人身上的柔弱特质，太过坚强刚性的女人，会让他们觉得有压力吧？

此时费郑氏正手捏着白色手帕，在手中揉来捏去，满眼的惶急与焦虑，她几乎没有操心过任何事，以前有丈夫，现在有女儿，所以一遇到点事情，就会焦虑不安，惶惶而不知所措。

费明兰快步上前握住母亲的手，问：「娘，哥哥怎样了？」

费郑氏双眼中泪花隐隐，紧紧反握住女儿的手，「还没醒呢！大夫刚刚来看过，开了药方，还在煎药。」

费明兰拍拍母亲的手背，「只是小争执，应该没什么大碍，您且坐下等等，我到里屋看看。」

费郑氏点了点头，又用手帕擦了擦眼角，「那两个少年也在里屋，你要小心应对。」

费明兰一愣，随即无奈地看着母亲，她怎么就放心让昏迷不醒的哥哥和「打人凶手」同处一室呢？

虽然服侍哥哥的下人们肯定也在，但是没有家人陪着，倒让两个凶手在那里看着……费明兰真是对自家母亲彻底无语了，行事没有个分寸到如此地步，也不知道父亲这些年是如何娇养她的，让她不知世事至此。

费明兰无语地转身向内室走进，立春快步走在前面为她打起帘子，向里面通报了声：「大小姐到了。」

在内室床前伺候的洗砚听闻此声，立即转身跪倒在地，惶恐地磕头，道：「大小姐，都是洗砚护主不力，才让少爷受了伤，还请大小姐责罚。」

在费家佣人的心里，第一怕的是原来的家主费忠贵，第二就是这位嫡小姐费明兰。

如今费忠贵已逝，费明兰自然荣升为第一怕了。

少爷一心读书，对待下人随和宽厚；主母只爱赏花赏月，对佣人向来都淡淡的；庶小姐娇弱，对佣人向来是笑脸相迎；只有嫡小姐向来治家严谨，规矩森严，言出令行，容不得半点差错。

费明兰并没有理会洗砚，先是疾步到床前看了看费明德，见他面色红润，宛如沉睡，并不像有大碍的模样，这才稍微放下心，转而又看向坐在窗前小几旁边的两个年轻男子，不由得眼前一亮。

她的目光率先被紫衣锦袍少年吸引住──好个精致美少年！

少年正值十五六岁，男女之别还不是很明显的年龄，肌肤晶莹如羊脂白玉，没有一点瑕疵，长眉入鬓，桃花眼波光潋滟，悬鼻精致挺拔，嫣唇薄而红润，五官当真增不得一分，减不得一分，几近完美。

更难得的是这少年气质华贵，紫色原本很难穿出精采，却将他衬托得贵气逼人，他的锦袍上绣了折枝葛巾紫牡丹，腰束巴掌宽同色绣花腰带，一侧坠白玉佩，一侧坠紫罗香囊，当真华贵无双、风流无限。

身为皇商之女，以及织造家章茹芸的闺阁手帕交，费明兰知道这少年穿的乃是专供皇室的贡品布料「暗花锦」，而他的这身折枝牡丹锦袍，因其紫色晕染得格外高雅纯正而更加希罕难得。

陡然意识到少年身分可能尊贵无比，高不可攀，费明兰的心一紧，暗暗捏了捏手掌心，哥哥这次怕是真的惹了大麻烦！

她转而又看了看另外那名年纪稍大，约莫十八九岁的青衣布袍青年，看第一眼，只是觉得青年五官端正，气质斯文，没有锦袍少年的抢眼夺目，但是再看第二眼，费明兰才暗自咋舌了──又一个大美男啊！

比之锦袍少年华丽喧嚣夺目的美，青年的俊美更内敛，宛如温玉，剑眉干净俐落却不显跋扈，星目幽深却又明澈，鼻梁同样高挺，薄唇同样嫣红，弧度却似乎更加诱人。

见费明兰怔怔地盯着自己，青年莞尔，扬唇一笑，费明兰顿时觉得眼前万花齐放，头晕目眩。

就算她呕心沥血培育的「素心如雪」，也没有青年这么一笑来得如此震撼！

世间怎会有如此美人，偏偏又是男子？

难怪好男色的书呆子哥哥都忍不住发了花痴，当众惹了麻烦。

费明兰干咳了一声，努力压制自己怦怦乱跳的小心脏，用最端庄的淑女姿态微微福身施了一礼，道：「家兄莽撞得罪了二位，小女子在此先代兄长赔礼了。」

锦袍少年微微抬了抬下巴，目光苛刻地打量了费明兰一番，见她身姿秾纤合度，五官秀丽精美，明明是娇柔美少女，却因为目光中的坚定沉稳，而让人不由暗自警醒，肃然起敬。

少年扭头看了看青年，暗暗点了点头，第一印象，此女绝不简单，不是那种空有其貌的花瓶，或者媚俗美人。

青年微笑道：「也是在下出手莽撞，不小心伤了令兄。」

费明兰尴尬笑笑，「想必是没有大碍的，如果能让他受些教训也是好的。」

少年却道：「咱们明人不说暗话，费小姐，令兄对我们无礼，就算告到衙门里也是我们有理。这次我们之所以跟来，一是为了顺道取『素心如雪』，其次是想让令兄对我们有个交代。」

费明兰大为惊讶，不由秀眉微挑，问：「您就是『素心如雪』的买家？」

少年下巴微扬，骄傲回答：「嗯？不行吗？」

费明兰忙笑道：「那真是小女子有眼不识泰山了，您是我们费家的贵客，怠慢了。立夏，快上好茶，就泡前些日子刚得的狮峰明前茶吧！」

立夏应了，快步而无声息地出去准备。

青年微微扬唇，笑道：「这下我们可真是沾光了，西湖龙井以狮峰最佳，而明前茶更是贵如金，小姐大方。」

费明兰微笑道：「与贵客相比，这点茶不值一提。」

第2章(2)

西湖龙井产于西湖西南的狮峰、龙井、云栖、梅家坞和虎跑村一带，故有「狮、龙、云、梅、虎」五个品类。

世人一般以为龙井产的龙井茶最正宗地道，其实最珍贵最美味的龙井茶产于狮峰山，这也是「狮、龙、云、梅、虎」狮字排在最前的原因。

狮峰明前茶每年的产量有限，基本上都做了御用的贡品，民间千金一两都难买得到。

费明兰之所以能用这极品茶叶待客，却是沾了费家「皇商」的光。

商人虽然地位低下，处于末流，但是「皇商」毕竟不同。这世间最尊贵的存在莫过于天子，天子所属的皇族自然是人间第一等，但凡能沐浴到一点点「皇恩」的，都能与众不同，鸡犬升天。

皇商，「皇」之一字在前，就连普通的官吏都得小心对待，不敢轻易得罪。皇商之家因为日常经手的大宗买卖都是进贡的御用制品，但凡手指缝里漏下一点什么，他们平时日常所用也能沾沾光，感受一下「御用之品」的高级享受是什么滋味。

这是独属于皇商的特权，是皇帝都默许的。

当然，皇商也不敢嚣张，他们当然会把最极品的物品进贡，自己所用的怎么都得要降一个等次，如果他们敢说自家和皇帝用同样的东西，那真是给几个脑袋都不够砍的。

就算如此，皇商之家见识、使用、品尝过的好东西，也确实比普通官吏之家要好的多。

「皇商」二字，简单明了，可附带的价值，才是费明兰所看重与不舍得放弃的最根本所在。

现在费家孤儿寡母的，如果再丢了「皇商」资格，偌大家产真的就只能任人宰割侵吞，父亲一辈子的心血都会付诸东流了。

立夏为客人敬上了狮峰明前茶，然后悄声退步到一边，静立着伺候，行动举止间大方得体，一看就训练有素，教养良好。
content_en:
Most men like the soft qualities in women. Women who are too strong and rigid will make them feel pressured, right?

At this time, Mrs. Fei Zheng was holding a white handkerchief in her hand, squeezing it back and forth. Her eyes were full of panic and anxiety. She had almost never worried about anything. She had a husband before and now has a daughter, so whenever something happened, she would be anxious, panicked and at a loss.

Fei Minglan quickly stepped forward, held her mother's hand, and asked, "Mom, how is my brother?"

There were tears in Fei Zheng's eyes, and she held her daughter's hand tightly, "I haven't woken up yet! The doctor just came to see her, prescribed the medicine, and is still brewing it."

Fei Minglan patted the back of her mother's hand and said, "It's just a small dispute. It should be nothing serious. Please sit down and wait while I go to the back room to take a look."

Fei Zheng nodded and wiped the corners of her eyes with a handkerchief. "Those two teenagers are also in the back room. You have to be careful when dealing with them."

Fei Minglan was stunned for a moment, and then looked at her mother helplessly. How could she feel comfortable letting her unconscious brother and the "murderer" live in the same room?

Although the servants who served his brother were definitely there, without his family accompanying him, the two murderers were left watching... Fei Minglan was completely speechless towards her mother, who acted so erratically, and didn't know how her father had pampered her all these years, leaving her ignorant of the world.

Fei Minglan turned around and walked into the inner room speechlessly. Li Chun quickly walked in front and opened the curtain for her, announcing inside: "The eldest lady has arrived."

When Xi Yan, who was waiting in front of the bed in the inner room, heard this, he immediately turned around and knelt on the ground, kowtowed in fear, and said, "Miss, it was Xi Yan's inability to protect the Lord that caused the young master to be injured. Please punish me."

In the hearts of Fei family servants, the first thing they fear is the original head of the family, Fei Zhonggui, and the second thing is Fei Minglan, the legitimate lady.

Now that Fei Zhonggui has passed away, Fei Minglan has naturally been promoted to the number one position.

The young master is dedicated to studying and is easy-going and generous towards his servants; the mistress only loves to admire flowers and the moon, and is always indifferent to the servants; the concubine is delicate and always greets the servants with a smile; only the eldest daughter has always been strict in running the house, strict in rules, and does not tolerate any mistakes.

Fei Minglan ignored the inkstone. First she hurried to the bed and looked at Fei Mingde. She saw that his face was rosy, as if he was sleeping, and he didn't look like he was in serious trouble. Then he felt relieved, and then looked at the two young men sitting next to the small table in front of the window, and his eyes lit up.

Her eyes were first attracted by the young man in purple robes and brocade robes - such an exquisite and beautiful young man!

The boy is fifteen or sixteen years old, an age when the distinction between men and women is not yet obvious. His skin is as clear as mutton-fat white jade, without any flaws. His eyebrows are long, his peach blossom eyes are sparkling, his nose is delicate and straight, his lips are thin and rosy, and his facial features are almost perfect.

What's even more rare is that this young man has a luxurious temperament. Purple is difficult to wear, but it makes him look very noble. His brocade robe is embroidered with purple peonies and a palm-width embroidered belt of the same color. He has a white jade pendant on one side and a violet sachet on the other. He is truly luxurious and charming.

As the daughter of an imperial merchant and the boudoir handkerchief of the weaver Zhang Ruyun, Fei Minglan knew that the young man was wearing "dark flower brocade", a tribute fabric specially provided for the royal family, and his peony brocade robe with broken branches was even more rare because of its extra elegant and pure purple color.

Suddenly realizing that the young man's status might be extremely noble and unattainable, Fei Minglan's heart tightened and she secretly squeezed her palms. Her brother might have really gotten into big trouble this time!

She turned to look at the other young man who was slightly older, about eighteen or nineteen years old. At first glance, she felt that the young man had good features and a gentle temperament, and was not as eye-catching as the young man in brocade robes. But after a second look, Fei Minglan was secretly speechless - another handsome man!

Compared with the gorgeous, noisy and eye-catching beauty of the young man in brocade robe, the youth's beauty is more restrained, like warm jade, the sword eyebrows are clean and neat but not domineering, the starry eyes are deep but clear, the bridge of the nose is equally high and straight, and the thin lips are equally bright red, but the curvature seems more attractive.

Seeing Fei Minglan staring at him blankly, the young man smiled and raised his lips in a smile. Fei Minglan suddenly felt that thousands of flowers were blooming in front of his eyes, making him dizzy.

Even if she had worked hard to cultivate the "Snow-like Snow", it would not be as shocking as the young man's smile!

How can there be such a beautiful woman in the world, but she is also a man?

No wonder the lecherous and nerdy brother couldn't help but become obsessed and got into trouble in public.

Fei Minglan coughed dryly, tried hard to suppress her pounding little heart, and bowed slightly in the most dignified ladylike manner, saying: "My brother has offended the two of you with his recklessness. I, the little girl, would like to apologize on behalf of my brother."

The young man in the brocade robe slightly raised his chin and looked at Fei Minglan with a harsh look. He saw that she had a slender figure and beautiful facial features. She was obviously a delicate and beautiful girl, but because of the firmness and calmness in her eyes, people couldn't help but be secretly alert and awe-struck.

The young man turned to look at the young man and nodded secretly. His first impression was that this girl was anything but simple. She was not the kind of vase with superficial appearance or a kitsch beauty.

The young man smiled and said, "I acted recklessly and accidentally hurt my brother."

Fei Minglan smiled awkwardly, "It must be nothing serious. It would be good if he could learn a lesson."

The young man said, "We are wise people and don't tell secrets. Miss Fei, if your brother is rude to us, we will be justified even if he files a lawsuit with the government. The reason why we came this time is, firstly, to take advantage of Su Xin Ruxue, and secondly, we want your brother to give us an explanation."

Fei Minglan was greatly surprised. She raised her eyebrows slightly and asked, "Are you the buyer of 'Su Xin Ru Xue'?"

The young man raised his chin slightly and replied proudly: "Huh? No?"

Fei Minglan hurriedly smiled and said: "That little girl is really ignorant of Mount Tai. You are a distinguished guest of our Fei family, so you are neglecting me. Lixia, hurry up and serve some good tea. Let's make the Shifeng Mingqian tea that we just got a few days ago!"

Rikka agreed and went out quickly and silently to prepare.

The young man raised his lips slightly and said with a smile: "Now we are really blessed. The West Lake Longjing is the best at Shifeng, and the Mingqian tea is as precious as gold. The lady is generous."

Fei Minglan smiled and said: "Compared with the distinguished guests, this tea is not worth mentioning."

Chapter 2(2)

West Lake Longjing is produced in the Shifeng, Longjing, Yunqi, Meijiawu and Hupao Village areas in the southwest of West Lake, so there are five categories: lion, dragon, cloud, plum and tiger.

People generally think that Longjing tea produced in Longjing is the most authentic. In fact, the most precious and delicious Longjing tea is produced in Shifeng Mountain. This is why the characters for "lion, dragon, cloud, plum, and tiger" are listed first.

The annual output of Shifeng Mingqian tea is limited, and most of it is used as a tribute to the royal family. It is difficult for ordinary people to buy it for even a tael.

The reason why Fei Minglan was able to serve guests with this top-quality tea was because of the credit of the "Imperial Merchant" of the Fei family.

Although merchants have a low status and are at the bottom of the stream, "imperial merchants" are different after all.The most noble being in this world is the emperor. The royal family to which the emperor belongs is naturally the first in the world. Anyone who can bathe in a little "emperor's favor" can be distinguished, and chickens and dogs can ascend to heaven.

Emperor merchants, with the word "emperor" in front of them, even ordinary officials must be treated with caution and do not dare to offend easily.Because the daily large-scale transactions handled by the Royal Merchant House are tribute products, if something slips through their fingers, they can use it for daily use and experience the high-end enjoyment of "imperial products".

This was a privilege that belonged exclusively to the imperial merchants and was tacitly approved by the emperor.

Of course, the emperor's merchants did not dare to be arrogant. Of course, they would pay tribute with the best items, and the items they used had to be downgraded. If they dared to say that they and the emperor used the same items, it would be hard to chop off even a few heads.

Even so, the good things that the Royal Merchant's House has seen, used, and tasted are indeed much better than those of ordinary officials' houses.

The word "Imperial Merchant" is simple and clear, but the value attached to it is what Fei Minglan values ​​most and is unwilling to give up.

Now that the Fei family is orphaned and widowed, if they lose their "Imperial Merchant" qualification, the family's property will really have no choice but to be slaughtered and embezzled, and the father's lifelong efforts will be in vain.

Li Xia served Shifeng Mingqian tea to the guests, then quietly stepped aside and stood quietly to serve. His actions were generous and decent, and he looked like he was well-trained and well-educated.
